subject.title: feat(gateway): add ticketed read-only MCP App host

question: Should OpenClaw accept this reusable, short-lived bearer ticket as the permanent authorization boundary for standalone read-only MCP App views?
rationale: Tests can prove the implemented invariants, but only maintainers can decide whether bounded URL-capability replay and exposure of leased App data outside normal Gateway authentication match the intended product security model.

options.title: Approve the bounded capability
options.body: Accept the current lease-bound, read-only ticket model after confirming exact-head CI and the documented origin, referrer, expiry, and binding invariants.

options.title: Require single-use exchange
options.body: Change the ticket to a one-time exchange or rotate it after initial load, accepting added reload and lifecycle complexity for a narrower replay window.

options.title: Pause standalone hosting
options.body: Defer this host until a concrete channel or browser-launch workflow establishes the required capability and recovery semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded capability
recommendation.body: Accept the current lease-bound, read-only ticket model after confirming exact-head CI and the documented origin, referrer, expiry, and binding invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom co-authored the current sandboxed MCP Apps implementation whose security boundary this PR extends.
